title: fix(metadata-protocol): the read naming no bundle member serves a declared override of the canonical member
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_

Fixes #32849

The last exit of the card: with #33815 (the member read) and #34169 (the layered member read), every read that serves Z's member now serves its declared override (see Acceptance notes for why nothing is left).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:X 发 `welcome` 邮件模板的 `fr-FR`,附加包 Z 发它的规范成员 `en-US`,App 的 `.custom` pair 存了一行声明覆盖 Z 的 `en-US`(`overrides.package: Z`)。#33815 / #34169 之后,点名 `?member=en-US` 的读已给出覆盖;但不点名成员的读(普通读、执行读、`?layers=true` 分层读,以及靠分层读找已发布行的 `/published`)仍给出 Z 原版 `zeta en-US`。现在它们与 `?member=en-US` 一致,给出覆盖。
- 为什么改:不点名成员就是读规范成员,和点名 `en-US` 是同一个请求;声明了的覆盖应在每个给出 Z 该成员的出口被服务(ADR-0146 D8 第 2 项、ADR-0150 D4),同一请求不能因写法不同给出两份内容。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个判定函数 `declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf`:不点名成员时按规范成员判定,而不是直接放弃;点名成员的读一字未动。未声明覆盖、未声明的 pair 行、声明给 X 的行(仍 409)、X 自己的成员、草稿读的地址、被禁用的 Z 均不变(已钉、已消融)。回滚即还原本 PR,存储数据不变。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` 中 `declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf` 开头 `addressed` 那两行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t 'naming no member'`,预期 7 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Own files (three): `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, `.changeset/32849-nomember-read-declared-override.md`. No edit to `protocol.ts`, `protocol-save.ts`, `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` or `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`: both callers already hand the predicate the selector they resolved (`undefined` when none was named), so the one predicate change reaches both.

`declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf` answered `undefined` when no member was named. It now judges the member the read addresses, `bundleMemberDiscriminator(type, member)`: the selector, or the canonical member (`en-US`) when none was named. That is the member `getMetaItem` and `getMetaItemLayered` read when no member is named, and naming the canonical value is the same request (`resolveBundleMemberSelector`'s contract). Every check below it (one enabled shipper of that member, no environment item of it, an active row of it that is the shipper's served override) is unchanged and now runs at that member. A type with no members still answers `undefined`. A bundle that ships no canonical member has no shipper of it, so it is left as it was.

| read (fixture: X ships `fr-FR`, Z ships `en-US`; both install orders) | before (`main` b8456ebd4a) | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| bare, no member, the pair row declares Z for `en-US` | `zeta en-US` | `pair en-US`, stamped Z, envelope Z (= `?member=en-US`) |
| bare execution read, no member, same row | `zeta en-US` | `pair en-US`, stamped Z |
| bare `?layers=true`, no member, same row | code `zeta en-US`, overlay null, effective `zeta en-US` | code `zeta en-US`, overlay `pair en-US`, effective `pair en-US`, envelope Z (= `?package=Z`) |
| `GET /meta/email_template/welcome/published`, same row (REST door, temporary probe) | no overlay found; fell through to the snapshot exit | 200 `pair en-US` (the layered read's overlay exit) |
| `?member=en-US`, `?package=Z`, layered `?member=en-US` | `pair en-US` | unchanged |
| bare `?member=fr-FR` (X's own) | `suitex fr-FR` | unchanged |
| strict draft read, no member, a pair draft pending | `pair en-US draft` (stamped the pair) | unchanged; the layered draft layer too |
| no row / undeclared pair row | `zeta en-US`, no overlay | unchanged |
| row declares X (#32606 shape) | 409 naming X and Z (plain and layered) | unchanged |
| Z disabled | plain: Z's withheld item; layered: no overlay | unchanged |
| door step 1c, `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal` | no refusal | unchanged |

Nothing refused becomes served or the reverse; no authorable key or value moves. Same reading as #33815 and #34169 (review-b, 6894129336): an existing declaration taking effect on one more read exit is `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the shared real-`SchemaRegistry` harness `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, beside #34169's: `[#32849] the read naming no member serves the pair's declared override of the canonical member an addition Z ships, as ?member=en-US does` (7 tests):

- fix pin, both install orders: plain bare (no member) equals `?member=en-US` (`pair en-US`, Z, Z); the execution read the same; bare layers equal `?package=Z`'s with `effective` deep-equal; step 1c refuses nothing; layered `?member=en-US` unchanged; X's `fr-FR` untouched.
- draft pin: the plain strict draft read naming no member serves the pair's draft; the layered draft layer is that draft; `?package=Z` has none.
- CONTROL no override x2 (no row / undeclared pair row): Z's own, no overlay, on plain, execution and layered.
- CONTROL row declares X: 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming X and Z on plain and layered.
- CONTROL Z disabled: plain answers Z's withheld item, layered has no overlay.

BASE measured on `main` b8456ebd4a before any edit, with a temporary probe in this harness (both install orders and the four CONTROL arrangements) and a temporary probe at the REST doors (`packages/rest`, real `SchemaRegistry`, the pair row stored and hydrated): plain bare and execution bare served `zeta en-US`; layered bare answered overlay null, effective `zeta en-US`; `?member=en-US`, `?package=Z` and layered `?member=en-US` served `pair en-US`. At the doors: `GET /meta/email_template/welcome` 200 `zeta en-US`, `/layers` effective `zeta en-US`, `/published` found no overlay. After the fix the same door probe answered 200 `pair en-US` on all three. Neither probe is committed.

<details><summary>Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, metadata-protocol rebuilt under the verify lock, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in dist, auto-restore blob equals HEAD (`17592e66` / `70eb6082`) with `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, marker absent from all 24 dist files)</summary>

Run: `-t 'naming no member'` (7 tests).

| | mutation | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | the fix reverted: `addressed` is the named `member` again (none named answers `undefined`) | 3 failed, 4 passed: both fix pins, `bare, no member: expected [ 'zeta en-US', 'com.acme.zeta', …(1) ] to deeply equal [ 'pair en-US', 'com.acme.zeta', …(1) ]`; the draft pin, `bare ?layers=true with drafts, no member: expected [ 'zeta en-US', 'pair en-US draft' ] to deeply equal [ 'pair en-US', 'pair en-US draft' ]` |
| A2 | `isServedOverrideRowOf(row, shipper, installed)` OR-ed with an always-true term | 2 failed, 5 passed: the undeclared-row CONTROL, `expected [ 'zeta en-US', 'pair en-US', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'zeta en-US', null, …(2) ]`; the X-declared CONTROL, `the read answered; a refusal was expected` |
| A3 | the plain read's draft guard removed (the strict draft read naming no member re-addressed to Z) | 1 failed, 6 passed: the draft pin, `No pending draft exists for email_template/welcome.` |
| A4 | the layered draft address taken after the arm re-addresses the read | 1 failed, 6 passed: the draft pin, `expected [ 'pair en-US', null ] to deeply equal [ 'pair en-US', 'pair en-US draft' ]` |
| A5 | the disabled-shipper guard made unreachable | 1 failed, 6 passed: the disabled CONTROL, `bare ?layers=true, no member: expected [ 'zeta en-US', 'pair en-US', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'zeta en-US', null, …(2) ]` |

A2's first attempt used a constant-foldable marker (`'…' !== ''`): the build folded it away, so the dist pre-flight could not find the marker, and the reading was discarded and taken again with a marker the build keeps (`String(row.id) !== '…'`); both attempts read the same. A5's first attempt never got the build lock (queue-timeout), so its green run was on the unmutated dist and was discarded; the second attempt is the one above. The no-row CONTROL is an unchanged-outcome pin by construction (no row, nothing to re-address).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Why `Fixes`:** the card asks that every exit serving Z's member serve the declared override. Exits now covered: the member read and the bare execution read (#33815); the layered member read (#34169); the plain, execution and layered reads naming no member, and `/published` through the layered read (this PR). Z's list, its execution list, `listServedOverrides` and `?package=Z` served it before #33815.
- **A bundle with no shipped canonical member** (X ships `fr-FR`, Z ships `de-DE`, the pair declares Z for `de-DE`): measured with the fix, the read naming no member serves X's `suitex fr-FR` (the registry's bare-name fallback) and never Z's member, so there is no Z exit there; the predicate is left as it was (no one shipper of `en-US`). In that arrangement the layered read naming no member answered no layers at all while the plain read served `suitex fr-FR`, measured at the protocol only; the predicate does not reach it (same on `main`). Noted here, not filed: the door reading was not taken (the verify lock timed out).
- **`/published`:** the door reads no query parameter, so its only exit is the read naming no member. In the door probe it moved from "no overlay" to 200 `pair en-US`. The before-side then fell through to the metadata service's snapshot (`getPublished`); the probe's snapshot double does not model email templates, so the harness answered 404 there. In a real kernel that exit serves the snapshot, which is not a refusal. No refused read became served and no served read became refused.
- Same declaration reading as #33815 and #34169: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch.
